title: Dear Culture With Panama Jackson
description:
S01 E09 — Is Usher a True R&B Legend?
Following the popularity of his "Tiny Desk" appearance, many are analyzing the music catalog of Usher; Panama Jackson is joined by music writer Matthew Allen to discuss whether Usher is an R&B legend.

title: Dear Culture With Panama Jackson
description:
S01 E10 — Boomerang: The Movie vs. the Soundtrack
A discussion of whether the movie "Boomerang," at its 30th anniversary, is still the cult classic it once was or if the soundtrack hits harder than the movie; author Bassey Ikpi joins Panama Jackson to talk about it.

title: Dear Culture With Panama Jackson
description:
S01 E11 — Will Owning Our Own Media Platforms Change the Game?
After his recent acquisition of the Black News Channel, entrepreneur Byron Allen -- owner of theGrio -- discusses the importance of Black representation in media.

title: Dear Culture With Panama Jackson
description:
S01 E12 — Bald Headed Games: Just a Phrase or a Way of Life?
"Bald headed games," a Black colloquial phrase known and practiced by so many and so little at the same time; Panama is joined by his panel of The Ill Informed Homies in order to dissect this term and the games that go along with it.

title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E04 — From the Big Screen to Your Book Shelf, Legendary Actor Omar Epps
Maiysha Kai sits down with actor Omar Epps, who gives an introspective look at his love for hip-hop, the film industry and the importance of being prepared for success.

title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E05 — The Person Behind the Viral Hashtag #DisabledandCute: Keah Brown
Maiysha Kai speaks with disability rights advocate and bestselling author Keah Brown about finding her writer's voice, making space for those who are disabled, and the backlash she received for wanting Lizzo and Beyoncé to remove an ableist slur.

title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E06 — Love and Madness Is \"Queenie\": Best Selling Author Candice Carty-Williams
Maiysha Kai sits down with bestselling author Candice Carty-Williams to talk about her critically acclaimed bestseller "Queenie," her new book "People Person" and her Black British musical that is being picked up by Netflix.

title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E07
Maiysha Kai talks with Black storytellers across the diaspora, speaking candidly about process, popular culture, publishing and how race inherently inspires and informs their work.
